financing.summary: Not a conventional for-sale homebuilder: JCCG is a private, founder-owned build-to-rent general contractor and lot developer, so most of the land and construction capital in its projects belongs to its clients, not to JCCG. Named or described capital sources are an unnamed publicly traded REIT (five communities), an unnamed publicly traded investment firm (which closed on the Dawsonville land together with JCCG in November 2024), a Trinitas Ventures / PCCP joint venture, NexMetro, AREY Group, BLDG Real Estate and a Scottsdale family office. Earlier (2021 to 2023) JCCG developed communities and sold them whole to institutional owners, including four communities of 971 homes closed in 2023. JCCG's own lenders, credit lines and balance sheet are not publicly disclosed, and no land banker or lot-option financier is named anywhere in its releases. For a land banker it is a weak direct customer (no for-sale takedown schedule, lots end up in rental ownership) but a possible channel: it delivered 1,040 finished lots in 2025, has a four-person land team, and its investor clients could use lot or development funding between land closing and vertical start.
financing.land_strategy: Capital-light by design. JCCG finds, entitles and develops sites and builds the homes, but under general-contractor or fee-build agreements for the investor or developer that owns the project; where JCCG originates the deal, the capital partner closes on the land with it. The company does not describe owned or optioned lot positions and states no land-light target.

lots.source_title: Jim Chapman Construction Group Earns 3 Building Design+Construction Rankings (company news)
lots.note: No owned/optioned lot table exists: lots are developed for clients. Published activity figures instead: 708 homes completed and 1,040 lots delivered in 2025; six projects totalling 1,210 lots launched in 2025; active pipeline of more than 11 communities and 2,500 homes (October 2026); projections of 1,306 lots and 1,375 homes for 2026 (January 2026 release) and 1,150 home completions in 2026 and 1,450 in 2027 (May 2026 release); career totals of about 5,000 lots and 4,000 homes delivered.

land_banking.counterparty: Unnamed publicly traded REIT (JCCG does not identify it)
land_banking.description: JCCG's largest repeat client: it develops the lots and builds 'Cottages' rental communities under general-contractor agreements, and the REIT owns them. The Cottages at Loxley, AL (250 homes, broke ground January 2026) is described as the fifth community with this REIT; Creekside Cottages, Opelika, AL (304 units) as the fourth; The Cottages at Villa Rica, GA (192 homes) was signed in August 2024.
land_banking.source_title: JCCG Breaks Ground on 250-unit BTR in Loxley (company news)
land_banking.note: This is the project-level capital source that stands where a land banker would. The REIT's name is not given in any JCCG release opened; a 2023 release describes clients only as a very large publicly traded REIT, an NYSE-listed S&P 500 REIT and a Scottsdale BTR developer. Property manager on Creekside Cottages is Capstone Communities.

land_banking.counterparty: Unnamed publicly traded investment partner (JCCG does not identify it)
land_banking.description: JCCG and this partner closed together on 34 acres in Dawsonville, GA on 2024-11-08 for The Cottages at Dawsonville (195 rental homes); JCCG then ran land development for about 11 months and went vertical in late 2025. Other releases call The Cottages at Capital Circle, Tallahassee (206 units) the second venture and Summerfield Cottages, Wildwood, FL (265 units) the third project with 'this publicly traded investment firm'.
land_banking.source_title: 195-Home Dawsonville BTR Community Coming Soon (company news)
land_banking.note: Shows the land pattern: JCCG sources and entitles the site and the capital partner takes title at closing, so JCCG itself does not carry the land. It is not clear from the releases whether this 'publicly traded investment firm' is the same entity as the 'publicly traded REIT' in the row above (the project counts do not reconcile).

land_banking.description: Avanza at Hyde Park, Noblesville, IN (237 duplexes and townhomes): owned by a newly formed joint venture of Trinitas Ventures and PCCP and developed by a Trinitas affiliate; JCCG is general contractor only. Construction began November 2025, first move-ins early 2027. JCCG's first Indiana job.
land_banking.source_title: JCCG Selected as GC for Avanza at Hyde Park (company news)
land_banking.note: JCCG is not a party to the joint venture.

land_banking.description: Phoenix-based BTR developer chose JCCG as general contractor (lots, homes, amenities) for South Pine in South Fulton County, GA, NexMetro's first Atlanta project (193 units per JCCG's project list; completed July 2025).
land_banking.source_title: NexMetro Selects JCCG as GC for Atlanta Market BTR Debut (company news)
land_banking.note: Third-party fee work; NexMetro owns the project.

land_banking.description: Owner and manager of Enclave at Marston, Gainesville, FL (75 attached rental homes); JCCG is general contractor. Announced August 2026.
land_banking.source_title: JCCG Announces Enclave at Marston in Gainesville, FL (company news)

land_banking.description: Developer of Fellowship at Higher Ground, Milledgeville, GA (91 independent-living rental homes in phase one, to be managed by The Fellowship Family); JCCG began land development November 2025.
land_banking.source_title: Higher Ground to Bring Independent Living Option to Milledgeville (company news)

land_banking.source_title: JCCG Named General Contractor for VLux Madison (company news)
land_banking.note: Takeover of a stalled third-party project; owner not named.

land_banking.description: General-contractor agreement signed January 2025 for a 365-home rental community on 48 acres at Heartwood at Richmond Hill, GA, built in two phases.
land_banking.source_title: JCCG Announces New Richmond Hill BTR Community (company news)
land_banking.note: Developer not named. Verification 2026-11-19: the cited release does not mention Indiana; a sentence linking this developer to JCCG's Indiana entry (from a different, uncited release) was moved out of the description, since nothing shows it is the same developer.

capital_events.description: JCCG and a publicly traded investment partner closed on 34 acres in Dawsonville, GA for The Cottages at Dawsonville (195 rental homes). Included as the one dated, public example of how land is capitalised in JCCG's projects.
capital_events.source_title: 195-Home Dawsonville BTR Community Coming Soon (company news)
capital_events.note: Purchase price and the partner's name not disclosed.

capital_events.description: During 2023 JCCG sold and closed four Georgia rental communities (Loganville, Brunswick, Hampton, Athens; 971 homes) to institutional owners, the tail of its earlier develop-and-sell model.
capital_events.source_title: Jim Chapman Construction Group Celebrates 25th Anniversary with Successful 2023 (company news)
capital_events.note: Prices and buyers not disclosed. Older context, kept because it shows JCCG has carried projects on its own account before.

gaps: JCCG's own credit facilities, construction lenders, bonding/surety and balance sheet: not publicly disclosed (private company, no SEC filings found; EDGAR full-text search returned 403 in this run)

Land banker or lot-option financier: none named. Links to Domain Real Estate Partners, Millrose Properties, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon: none seen in the company's releases, but outside sources were not searched for these names, so this is unchecked rather than a confirmed negative

M&A 2025 to date: none found in the company's full 2025-2026 news archive. Chapco Design Build (May 2025) is an internally launched commercial/amenity contracting division, not an acquisition. Outside sources were not searched for deals

Owned versus optioned lots, land held on JCCG's own balance sheet, and whether JCCG co-invests in client projects: not publicly disclosed
